messages.en:
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}What?!{01 00 00 05 00} You're just gonna
GIVE me this fossil?!{01 00 00 05 00}
For real?{01 00 00 0a 00} For REALLY real?
{07 13 00}Oh, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} you are 
WAY too nice!{01 00 00 05 00} You're the
best person in HISTORY!
OK then, {01 00 00 05 00}I gotta give you 
something cool in return,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Mida?!{01 00 00 05 00} Sa lihtsalt ANNAD
mulle selle fossiili?!{01 00 00 05 00}
Päriselt?{01 00 00 0a 00} PÄRIS päriselt?
{07 13 00}Oh, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} sa oled 
PALJU liiga kena!{01 00 00 05 00} Sa oled
parim inimene AJALOOS!
Olgu siis, {01 00 00 05 00}pean sulle andma 
midagi lahedat vastu,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{07 18 00}Huh??{01 00 00 0a 00} You're really gonna
give little old me
{04 1a 00}?
{07 02 00}LIKE, WOW!{01 00 00 05 00} TOTALLY WOW!!{01 01 00}
Well, if you really wanna
part with it, I'll take it...
But {01 00 00 05 00}I gotta give YOU a
present in exchange,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{07 18 00}Ah??{01 00 00 0a 00} Sa annad tõesti
vaesele minule
{04 1a 00}?
{07 02 00}NAGU, VAU!{01 00 00 05 00} TÄIESTI VAU!!{01 01 00}
Noh, kui sa tõesti tahad
sellest loobuda, võtan...
Aga {01 00 00 05 00}ma pean SULLE vastu
kingituse tegema,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{07 04 00}Wow!{01 00 00 0a 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, did you 
dig this up all by yourself,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}{07 13 00}It's SO adorable!{01 00 00 0a 00} It's, like,
the cutest thing I've ever
seen in my whole life!
OK, {01 00 00 05 00}so in exchange for this,{01 00 00 05 00}
I'm gonna give you a totally
special gift!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{07 04 00}Vau!{01 00 00 0a 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, kas sa 
kaevasid selle ise välja,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}{07 13 00}See on NII armas!{01 00 00 0a 00} See on,
nagu, kõige nunnum asi,
mida olen elus näinud!
Olgu, {01 00 00 05 00}nii et vastutasuks{01 00 00 05 00}
annan ma sulle täiesti
erilise kingi!
